text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Foreskpank and Krediidipank are to appeal to the courts after St Petersburg's tax police froze their accounts over alleged tax irregularities.
- Jazz group Manhattan Transfer have begun to tour Estonia, celebrating its 25th anniversary.
- President Lennart Meri gave departing U.S. ambassador Lawrence Taylor Estonia's highest award, the Cross of Terra Mariana.
- Leningrad province deputy governor Yuri Sokolov and Transport Minister Raivo Vare signed an agreement on building a new bridge between Narva and neighbouring Ivangorod.
- Leading fuel companies raised petrol prices by 25 cents, saying world oil prices were rising.
